notes:
Zaiqa Billing, Zaiqa Waiter and Zaiqa Kitchen apps, version 2.22.0.

New: Khata Book (Admin app and Windows)
• Khata is now its own section with two tabs: Customers and Staff. Totals, overdue days, search, sort and filters
• Account ledger: every given and paid amount with a running balance, date filters and search
• Mistakes can be fixed: change price, items, amount, date or note of any entry. It needs the admin PIN and a reason, and every change is kept in a history. Entries are voided, never deleted
• Receive payment by Cash, Online or Card, with a printed or WhatsApp receipt
• Staff khata: advances, meals and cash back. When paying salary you can deduct the staff khata in one tap
• Print or send a statement for any customer or staff: thermal receipt, A4 / PDF or WhatsApp
• Reports: age of debt, top debtors, collected this month, CSV export. Optional credit limit warning
